changelog:
chatmosp-msr-generator 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Introduces MSR (Multiscale Structure Reconstruction) engine for ChatMOSP, executing Wulff cluster generation and visualization.
- Validates input parameters and warns users about large cluster sizes (R ≥ 50Å) before running calculations.
- Automatically generates structure files (ini.xyz, {task_name}_cluster.xyz) and creates both static PNG images and GIF rotation animations.
- Sends results directly to users via Feishu, including brief structural descriptions.
- Integrates with companion ChatMOSP skills for parameter preparation, file organization, and workflow handoff.
